title: Elevated 5xx errors on compute-svc
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on compute-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] compute-svc 2026-04-06 15:03-17:43: compute-svc: 111 of 171 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-06 15:03 and 2026-04-06 17:43 UTC (peak error ratio 0.85 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.

_templates.macro: Launch-template change moved {svc} to a smaller instance type.

culprit.diff:
@@ -9,3 +9,3 @@ aws_launch_template.compute_svc
 resource "aws_launch_template" "compute_svc" {
-  instance_type = "m5.2xlarge"
+  instance_type = "m5.large"
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Launch-template change moved compute-svc to a smaller instance type.
rca.micro: infra/compute-svc.tf:10 sets instance_type m5.2xlarge -> m5.large on aws_launch_template.compute_svc.
rca.remediation: Restore instance_type = m5.2xlarge on aws_launch_template.compute_svc (terraform tf-r1).

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `out of memory: killed process <*>`.
